name: VKS3D
summary: An in-development universal stereoscopic 3D Vulkan driver by ThreeDeeJay. Currently marked as an AI proof-of-concept and not yet functional. Aims to provide Dual-View Rendering for Vulkan games similarly to Helifax's Vk3DVision, but as a fully open-source project with no NDA-encumbered code.
compatibility_notes: Not yet functional — listed for tracking purposes. Do not use for actual game fixes. Watch the repository for progress updates.
